configDescriptions.metric_retention_days: Retention period for CPU, memory, disk and network metrics (days, shared across all log databases)
configDescriptions.log_retention_days_postgres: PostgreSQL retention period for access logs and observability data (days)
configDescriptions.sw_offline_domains: Domains using the Service Worker offline fallback (JSON array; no domains means the fallback is inactive)
configDescriptions.sw_offline_enabled: Enable the Service Worker offline fallback
configDescriptions.sw_offline_html: Custom HTML for the offline contact page; leave empty to use the built-in template
configDescriptions.origin_error_page_get_only: Show the origin error page only for GET requests; pass other methods through
configDescriptions.origin_error_page_status_codes: Status code tags that trigger the origin error page (JSON array)
configDescriptions.origin_error_page_html: Custom HTML for the origin error page; leave empty to use the built-in template
configDescriptions.openresty_default_limit_req_per_ip: Default request rate limit per IP; leave empty to disable (for example, 10r/s or 100r/m)
configDescriptions.openresty_default_limit_conn_per_server: Default concurrent connection limit per site; 0 disables the limit
configDescriptions.openresty_default_limit_conn_per_ip: Default concurrent connection limit per IP; 0 disables the limit
configDescriptions.openresty_default_limit_rate: Default bandwidth limit per request; leave empty to disable
configDescriptions.pages_max_history_count: Maximum historical deployments retained per Pages project; 0 means unlimited
configDescriptions.pages_max_package_size_mb: Maximum Pages deployment package upload size (MiB)
configDescriptions.openresty_large_client_header_buffers: Buffers for large client request headers
configDescriptions.openresty_proxy_busy_buffers_size: Maximum size of busy proxy response buffers
configDescriptions.openresty_gzip_min_length: Minimum response size for Gzip compression
configDescriptions.openresty_cache_use_stale: Conditions for serving stale cached responses
configDescriptions.node_offline_threshold: Time without a heartbeat before a node is considered offline (milliseconds)
configDescriptions.openresty_default_server_return_status: HTTP status code returned by the default server
configDescriptions.openresty_events_multi_accept_enabled: Enable accepting multiple connections at once
configDescriptions.relay_frps_web_ui_port: Port for the built-in FRPS web administration interface
configDescriptions.relay_frps_web_ui_enabled: Enable the built-in FRPS web administration interface
configDescriptions.max_api_keys_per_user: Maximum API keys each regular user can create
configDescriptions.log_db_migration: Flag indicating that log database writes are frozen during migration
configDescriptions.login_session_ttl_hours: Login session lifetime in hours; 0 ends the session when the browser closes, -1 never expires
configDescriptions.disk_cache_lru_enabled: Enable least recently used (LRU) cache eviction
configDescriptions.file_access_whitelist: File business types accessible without signing in (JSON array)
configDescriptions.smtp_host: SMTP server address, for example smtp.example.com
configDescriptions.registration_enabled: Allow users to register their own accounts (true/false)
configDescriptions.oidc_login_enabled: Allow sign-in through third-party OIDC providers
configDescriptions.menu_display_config: Menu visibility configuration (JSON string mapping URLs to enabled states)
configDescriptions.search_engine_indexing_enabled: Allow search engines to crawl and index this site (true/false)
configDescriptions.update_upstream_repository: Upstream GitHub Actions release repository (owner/repo or GitHub repository URL)
configDescriptions.storage_config: File storage driver and connection settings (JSON)
configDescriptions.password_register_enabled: Allow local accounts to be created with a password
configDescriptions.cap_auto_solve: Start solving the challenge when the page loads; otherwise require a user click
configDescriptions.cap_challenge_count: Number of PoW challenges the client must solve; default 1, recommended 1 to 5
configDescriptions.server_address: Server URL used to restrict allowed origins; leave empty to allow any origin

login_email.name: Sign-in verification email
login_email.description: Verification email sent during password sign-in. Available variable: {{.Code}}

register_email.name: Registration verification email
register_email.description: Verification email sent during registration. Available variable: {{.Code}}
